purpose: mitosis splits a batch of changes or a document into parts built in parallel, gates each acceptance test on failing without the work, and opens one pull request per part.

objectives.text: Split the work into independently reviewable MSPs whose branches write exactly their declared files.
Gate every acceptance test on actually failing without the work.
Open one pull request per MSP.
Carry the run's own spend, priced at write time by exact model id in the five token kinds.

run.start.description: Written once when an invocation's run directory is known, before any stage runs.
questions: Which invocations ran, in which mode, and with which models?

mode.description: What kind of invocation this was.
mode.reading: plan-only stops before the build; build is a first build; resume continues a run directory without pushing; ship is a resume allowed to push.
mode.question: Which invocations planned, built, resumed or shipped?

input.description: Which front end the work came through.

state.description: The MSP's final state in this invocation.
state.excludes: The MSP's reason and pull-request text, which the store never holds.
state.reading: shipped opened a pull request; pushed pushed without one; unchanged added nothing; committed held on its local branch; ship-failed when a commit, push or pull-request command failed; blocked by a Lane or a producer MSP; referee-reverted when a Worker wrote a referee path, which mitosis restored before holding the MSP back ungated and unpushed.
state.question: How many MSPs reached a pull request?

gate.measured_from: The gate's worst property outcome: inert, then inconclusive, then pass.
gate.excludes: Each property's reason, which the store never holds.
gate.reading: pass means every acceptance test failed without the work; inert means one passed without it; inconclusive means one could not be judged; not-applicable means none could run; null means the gate could not run.
gate.question: Were the acceptance tests proven to fail without the work?

reconcile_clean.description: Whether reconcile found nothing for the MSP.
reconcile_clean.reading: true means no finding; null means the MSP was not reconciled.
reconcile_clean.question: Did this MSP write exactly its declared files?

usd.description: The dollars the run's own sessions, priced when the summary was written.
usd.measured_from: Tokens times the price table's per-million prices by exact model id.
usd.reading: 0 means nothing priced was found; null means the price is unknown.
usd.question: What did the run's own sessions cost?

tokens.measured_from: Assistant message usage in the counted transcripts.
tokens.includes: Every counted assistant message once by its message id.
tokens.excludes: Messages of child runs and messages outside the run's span for the caller.
tokens.reading: Null when spend could not be read.
tokens.question: How many tokens did the run use?

input.measured_from: The message usage field for input.
input.question: How many input tokens were used?

cache_write_5m.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_write_5m.
cache_write_5m.question: How many cache_write_5m tokens were used?

cache_write_1h.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_write_1h.
cache_write_1h.question: How many cache_write_1h tokens were used?

cache_read.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_read.
cache_read.question: How many cache_read tokens were used?

output.measured_from: The message usage field for output.
output.question: How many output tokens were used?

spend.description: The run's own spend by source and exact model id.
spend.measured_from: The transcripts of the sessions this invocation started and the caller's window.
spend.includes: Worker, structure, brief and caller messages.
spend.excludes: Child runs, whose spend their own summaries carry.
spend.reading: An empty list means no counted message was found.
spend.question: Where did the run's spend go?

items.reading: One record per source and model.
items.question: What did this source spend on this model?

source.reading: worker is a Lane's Worker; structure and brief are stage Workers; caller is the invoking session inside the run's span.
source.question: Which part of the run spent it?

tokens.measured_from: Assistant message usage in the counted transcripts.
tokens.includes: Every counted assistant message once by its message id.
tokens.excludes: Messages of child runs and messages outside the run's span for the caller.
tokens.reading: Null when spend could not be read.
tokens.question: How many tokens did the run use?

input.measured_from: The message usage field for input.
input.question: How many input tokens were used?

cache_write_5m.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_write_5m.
cache_write_5m.question: How many cache_write_5m tokens were used?

cache_write_1h.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_write_1h.
cache_write_1h.question: How many cache_write_1h tokens were used?

cache_read.measured_from: The message usage field for cache_read.
cache_read.question: How many cache_read tokens were used?

output.measured_from: The message usage field for output.
output.question: How many output tokens were used?

usd.description: The dollars this source and model, priced when the summary was written.
usd.measured_from: Tokens times the price table's per-million prices by exact model id.
usd.reading: 0 means nothing priced was found; null means the price is unknown.
usd.question: What did this source and model cost?

prices_date.description: The date of the price table the spend was priced with.
prices_date.reading: Null when spend could not be read.
prices_date.question: Which prices does usd use?

unpriced_models.reading: Empty means every counted model was priced.
unpriced_models.question: Is usd missing a model's cost?

sessions_missing.description: The number of calls whose transcript was not found.
sessions_missing.measured_from: Counted by mitosis as it ran.
sessions_missing.includes: Calls with no session id and calls whose transcript is gone.
sessions_missing.reading: 0 means every expected session was found; null means spend could not be read.
sessions_missing.question: Is usd partial?

spend_complete.description: Whether every expected session was found and every model priced.
spend_complete.reading: false means usd is a partial sum.
spend_complete.question: Can usd be taken as the whole own spend?

children.description: Every run in the store whose parent is this run.
children.measured_from: The store's event and summary lines.
children.excludes: Grandchildren, which name their own parent.
children.reading: Children's usd is never added to this run's usd; an empty list means no child run was found.
children.question: Which plugin runs did this run start?

run.measured_from: Its file name in the store.
run.question: Which run was it?

usd.description: The child's usd from its own summary.
usd.reading: Null when the child has no summary.
usd.question: What did the child cost?

missing.description: Whether the child has no summary.
missing.reading: true means the child's usd is unknown.
missing.question: Is the child's cost known?

spend_scope.reading: own means children are listed and never summed.
spend_scope.question: Does usd include child runs?

queries.name: recent_runs
queries.question: What did the most recent mitosis runs do and cost?
queries.sql: SELECT run, mode, exit, steps, msps, wall_seconds, usd FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: lane_states
queries.question: How did the Lanes end across runs?
queries.sql: SELECT 'ok' AS state, coalesce(sum(lane_states.ok), 0) AS lanes FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'failed' AS state, coalesce(sum(lane_states.failed), 0) AS lanes FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'blocked' AS state, coalesce(sum(lane_states.blocked), 0) AS lanes FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'merge-blocked' AS state, coalesce(sum(lane_states.merge_blocked), 0) AS lanes FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'held' AS state, coalesce(sum(lane_states.held), 0) AS lanes FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis'

queries.name: gate_outcomes
queries.question: How did the acceptance gates come out across runs?
queries.sql: SELECT 'pass' AS outcome, coalesce(sum(gates.pass), 0) AS gates FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'inert' AS outcome, coalesce(sum(gates.inert), 0) AS gates FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'inconclusive' AS outcome, coalesce(sum(gates.inconclusive), 0) AS gates FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'not-applicable' AS outcome, coalesce(sum(gates.not_applicable), 0) AS gates FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis'

queries.name: msp_outcomes
queries.question: How many MSPs reached each state, a pull request included?
queries.sql: SELECT 'shipped' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.shipped), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'pushed' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.pushed), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'unchanged' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.unchanged), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'committed' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.committed), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'ship-failed' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.ship_failed), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' UNION ALL SELECT 'blocked' AS state, coalesce(sum(msp_states.blocked), 0) AS msps FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis'

queries.name: parallelism
queries.question: Did the Lanes of each run build in parallel?
queries.sql: SELECT run, lane_width, peak_parallel, concurrency FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis' AND lane_width IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: spend_by_model
queries.question: Where did mitosis's own spend go, by source and model?
queries.sql: SELECT row.source AS source, row.model AS model, round(sum(row.usd), 6) AS usd FROM (SELECT unnest(spend) AS row FROM summaries WHERE plugin = 'mitosis') GROUP BY row.source, row.model ORDER BY usd DESC NULLS LAST
